parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotation lid of a storage box made of wood. It is a flat rectangular panel attached to the base body via a hinge mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: The lid covers and protects the contents of the box. It can be lifted or closed to access or secure the interior space.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a hinge axis located at the back edge, allowing it to open and close smoothly.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of a storage box made of wood. It forms the main container structure with four sides and a bottom panel.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main compartment for storing items, providing structural support and stability to the box.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal operation, serving as the fixed base for the rotating lid.
